label_origin: team judgement from report text; held-out set, labelled before any module run; draft by assistant, pending review
trl_rationale: Four CubeSats demonstrated all four technologies on orbit over several months in the operational environment. A technology demonstration mission, not an operational science mission, so 7 rather than 9.

evidence.quote: The four satellites were able to successfully establish a network at multiple data rates and demonstrate file transfer and command issuance between spacecraft over the network.
StarFOX successfully applied its algorithms to navigate multiple spacecraft targets simultaneously, using star tracker imagery.
The swarm operated for four months in the in-train formation.
